text.p: Ing Barings said it was maintaining its hold recommendation for Compania Nacional de Chocolates, Colombia's leading coffee and cocoa processing company.
"We base our hold recommendation on our expected 9.8 percent total share return by year-end," Barings said in a statement.
It said the company's price earnings ratios for 1997 and 1998 were 10.4x and 8.4x respectively, at slight discounts to the Colombian food and beverage sector.

Because of a recent rise in world coffee prices, and a run up in the equities market, Barings said it had increased its estimate of Chocolates' earnings per share to $0.88 in 1997 and $0.97 in 1998. ((-- Tom Brown, Bogota newsroom, 571 610 7944))
